brief.prose: Arizona is splitting the backfield on purpose: Mike LaFleur calls Love's ankle "a maintenance thing" and the staff has insisted on sharing touches with Tyler Allgeier to manage his workload, after Allgeier out-snapped him 36-30 in Week 4 on the strength of his pass protection. The path to a lead role runs through a healthy ankle and game scripts that keep Arizona running; the cap is that a trailing team hands the passing-down and late snaps to Allgeier. Watch whether the touch split widens in a competitive game, not in a blowout.
brief.rationale: Workload is being deliberately managed around an ankle and shared with Allgeier, and blowout scripts strip his snaps; a lead-back projection probably has not priced either.
